messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed to production (canary->100%) 3345678901. Release: inference-server v3.14.0, runtime patch r7. Post-deploy smoke triggered.

olivia: seeing a weird 'scanline' pattern in the embed synthetic probe p95 — short bursts of 502s around 12:46 UTC.

olivia: probe output snippet:
```
probe: embed-scan-01
seq=long | reqs=120 | errors=6 (5x502,1x504) | p95=380ms -> spike
```

raj: what's the distribution? 502s only on seq>1024?

olivia: yes, failures only on sequences > 1000 tokens and only in eu-west (eu1).

marta: can we repro with local stresser? starting a run against eu1 variant now. cc @li

li: if repros, i'd prefer pinning eu1 to v3.13.2 while we triage. lower blast radius.

oncall-bot: alert created #inc-3345 - prod-eu-embed-502-spike, severity=minor, paging oncall.

raj: repro run started. initial traces show 'kvcache-miss-fanout' in 2 of the failing requests.

marta: can we toggle prefix cache bypass to rule out stale kv behavior? quick ramp test, i'm on it.

olivia: also noticed correlation with warmstart windows — failures cluster right after node allocation.

li: decision time: hold rollout or pin?

raj: provisional plan: hold broad rollout for 45m and pin eu1 to v3.13.2. i'll prepare rollback PR if repro confirms.

marta: toggle applied -> prefix_cache_bypass=true for embed route on eu1, rerunning synth.

deploy-bot: smoke results (eu1, after bypass):
```
total=200 reqs, errors=0, p95=360ms
```
no more 502s in this sample.

olivia: good signal. looks like kvcache fanout issue. creating tracing ticket and RCA epic.

li: OK to unpin after fix. propose staged rollforward: patch kvcache fanout in canary then gradual.

raj: opened PR #4721 for mitigation config + unit test, tagging @marta for review.

marta: reviewing now, LGTM. once CI passes i'll trigger cautious canary.

olivia: thanks folks. marking this thread as follow-up-in-progress — monitor eu1 for the next hour and report any regressions. :thumbsup:
